$comment: Authored by hand on 2026-09-21. The 21st CLI is not installed in this environment and no 21st MCP server was available, so this file was NOT produced by `21st init --design-context` and contains no 21st library references. If the CLI is installed later, re-run init and merge.

stack.styling: StyleSheet.create with theme tokens — no Tailwind, no CSS-in-JS
constraints: React Native primitives only — no clip-path, no CSS grid, no pseudo-elements
Web-only effects must sit behind Platform.select
Static web export via expo export --platform web

decisions.decision: Single page container: 1240px, gutters 24/20/16. Navbar and page content consume the same token so alignment is structural.
Four variants (primary, secondary, ghost, destructive). One radius: 10px. Pills reserved for chips and badges.
error #D4183D, warning #B45309, notification #F4823A, info #2251D6. Previously error/warning/notification were all #F4823A.

decisions.problem: Three property card implementations render the same listing three ways across surfaces, one of them on a third colour palette (feedColors, #0a8a2a).

implementations.treatment: photo on top, white body below
full-bleed photo, text overlaid on gradient

decisions.awaiting: user review of the spec before any component work
